beats.text: Your H100 GPU is idling. Even with FlashAttention-2, you are barely hitting 35% utilization, leaving massive compute potential trapped behind memory bandwidth bottlenecks.
beats.visual_focus: A bar chart showing GPU utilization hovering at 35% with a red 'Idle' zone.

beats.text: Think of the GPU like a factory floor where the workers stop to wait for parts from the warehouse before every single assembly step.
beats.visual_focus: An animation of a worker standing still while a conveyor belt moves slowly.

beats.text: FlashAttention-3 introduces async pipelining. It uses Tensor Cores and TMA to overlap data movement with computation, effectively hiding memory latency behind active math operations.
beats.visual_focus: A split-screen showing 'Load' and 'Compute' bars overlapping perfectly in time.

beats.text: By interleaving block-wise matmul and softmax, and leveraging FP8 precision, we stop the stall and keep the GPU cores fed with a constant stream.

feynman_certification.listener_verdict: The hook is solid—telling me my expensive hardware is idling is the fastest way to get me to stop scrolling. I actually liked the factory analogy in Beat 2 because it wasn't some 'magic box' nonsense; it accurately described the memory-bound bottleneck. Beat 3 and 4 were technical enough to keep me interested without sounding like a textbook. I didn't feel talked down to, which is rare for these types of videos.
